sentences.quote: As MSCI's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Henry Fernandez has led the firm for three decades to its position today as a premier provider of indexes and portfolio-construction and risk-management tools, as well as climate and sustainability data and research, across public and private assets.
sentences.text: Henry A. Fernandez is Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of MSCI Inc., which he has led for three decades into its position as a provider of indexes and portfolio-construction and risk-management tools as well as climate and sustainability data and research across public and private assets.
He has served as a director and Chairman of MSCI since 2007 and as Chief Executive Officer since 1998, and he became head of the MSCI business in 1996 and led the company through its IPO in 2007.
